senses.gloss: † चय् चय्, i. 1, Ātm. To go.

चाय् चाय्, i. 1, Par., Ātm. To worship.
 --With the prep. नि नि, To worship, Daśak. 174, 5.
 --Cf. चि.

चय चय, i. e. चि + अ, m.
 1. A heap, Mārk. P. 21, 86.
 2. A mass, MBh. 3, 16426.
 3. A multitude, Caurap. 34.
 4. Arranged fuel, Hariv. 2161.
 5. A mound of earth, a rampart, Rām. 5, 9, 15.
 --Comp.
चयन चयन, i. e. चि + अन, n. Arranged fuel, Draup. 2, 7.
